Goal: Showing 0 Open EPICS in the Orange Tab but none listed

Showing 0 Open EPICS in the Orange Tab but none listed

Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/attachments/ag1muy43m8a-image.png

Typecheck and tests pass.

**Root cause:** `EpicDisplayStatus` includes `'proposed'` (epicDerive.ts:25), but `STATUS_GROUP_ORDER` in `src/renderer/lib/epicQueueControls.ts` only listed `['running', 'needs', 'queued', 'draft', 'completed']`. `groupEpics()` buckets epics by status but only keeps buckets whose key is in that order list, so `'proposed'` epics (which pass the "Open" filter and get counted) were silently dropped when building display sections — chip said "Open 2" while the list rendered "No Epics match these filters."

**Fix:** added `'proposed'` to `STATUS_GROUP_ORDER`, placed first to match `epicDisplayStatus`'s own documented priority (proposed outranks all other in-flight states). This is a pre-existing 10-Epic active-index bug in this repo, unrelated to any current uncommitted diff — no other files needed changes.
